scan.barcode.purpose: Add a card by scanning its barcode with the camera

barcode.render.purpose: Show a card’s barcode full screen and bright, so the cashier can scan it

notify.local.purpose: Remind you a week before a card or voucher expires

files.io.purpose: Back up your cards to a file, or add cards from one

share.purpose: Send a card’s store and number to someone you choose

widget.home.purpose: Show your most-used cards on your home screen

media.pick.purpose: Pick a screenshot or photo of a card to read its barcode

dataFlows.purpose: Your cards, saved as a backup file in a place you choose
A card’s store and number, when you tap Share

fullScreen.label: Open cards full screen
fullScreen.help: The code shows bright and large, so it scans easily. Close it to see the card’s details.

expiryReminders.label: Remind me before a card expires

display.title: =item.store
display.subtitle: =item.expired ? t('expiredLine', {'date': formatDate(item.expires, 'yMMMd')}) : coalesce(item.holder, '') != '' ? coalesce(item.holder, '') : t('endsIn', {'digits': substring(item.number, max(size(item.number) - 4, 0))})

number.label: Card number
number.help: Scan the barcode, or type the number printed under it. The barcode type is worked out from the number.

checks.message: That is too long for a card number.
The last digit of this EAN-13 doesn’t match the rest of the number. Check the number.
The last digit of this EAN-8 doesn’t match the rest of the number. Check the number.
The last digit of this UPC-A doesn’t match the rest of the number. Check the number.
UPC-E needs 6 digits, or 7 or 8 starting with 0 or 1.
The last digit of this UPC-E doesn’t match the rest of the number. Check the number.
Code 39 takes capital letters, digits, spaces and - . $ / + %.
Code 128 takes plain letters, digits and symbols.
Code 93 takes plain letters, digits and symbols.
Codabar takes digits and - $ : / . +, with A, B, C or D at both ends or at neither.
ITF needs an even number of digits, at least 6.

format.label: Barcode type
format.help: Automatic draws EAN-13, EAN-8 or UPC-A when the number is one with a matching last digit, and Code 128 otherwise. Scanning a card sets its type for you. Pick another type only if the shop’s scanner can’t read the code.

holder.label: Name on the card
holder.help: Handy when the family shares cards.

note.label: Note
note.placeholder: Discount day, where to show it…

color.label: Colour
color.help: The colour of the card in your list. Leave it empty to use the colour of the kind of shop.

hueName.label: Colour name
hueName.compute: =upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#D32F2F' ? 'red' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#C2185B' ? 'pink' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#7B1FA2' ? 'violet' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#512DA8' ? 'indigo' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#1976D2' ? 'blue' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#0288D1' ? 'cyan' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#00897B' ? 'teal' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#388E3C' ? 'green' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#F9A825' ? 'amber' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#EF6C00' ? 'orange' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#6D4C41' ? 'brown' : upper(coalesce(item.color, '')) == '#546E7A' ? 'grey' : optionHue(item.group)

checkDigitOk.label: Last digit matches
checkDigitOk.help: For EAN and UPC codes, the last digit is worked out from the others; a card whose last digit doesn’t match can’t be drawn.

empty.title: No cards yet
empty.body: Scan the barcode on a loyalty card, or tap Add and type its number. Your cards stay on this phone.

empty.title: No archived cards
empty.body: Archive a card you no longer use to hide it from the list.
